做我的狗（做我的狗（第22页）云峰则看着田伯光等人冷笑道，说出了这番话来。“好好，一定，我们一定照办，从现在开始我田伯光就是前辈的狗，就算前辈让我吃屎我都吃。”田伯光跪在地上对云峰磕头，其余的玄阴门的修士也是一样。“呵呵，为了防止你们叛变，这毒药你们必须吃下。”云峰微笑道，伸出了手掌，只见他的手掌里有很多黑色的一粒一粒的小药丸子，药丸子似乎是毒药。“什么？让我们吃毒药。”看到云峰手上的小丸子，田伯光的脸色变了，有点犹豫。啪！下一秒，云峰反手一巴掌打在了田伯光的脸上，将他打翻在地。田伯光的半边脸都肿起来了，嘴里冒着鲜血，牙齿也碎了很多颗。“吃药，还是死，自己选，我的耐心有限的。”云峰则冷冷的道。“吃，还是吃药吧。”田伯光哭泣道，还是选择了吃药，如今他还不想死。田伯光用手拿了一颗药丸子放入了嘴里吞咽了下去，药丸子很苦很臭，田伯光也不知道这到底是什么毒药。看到门主都吃了，其余的玄阴门的修士也只好过来拿了一颗云峰手里的药丸子，放入了嘴里吃下去了。“很好，这毒药是断肠散，在一个月内如果没有我的独门解药的话，你们就会肠子腐烂而死，不过只要你们乖乖的听话，我是会给你们解药的，离开了秘境就给你们解药。”云峰则看着他们冷笑道，说出了毒药的名称来。“知道了前辈！”“呜呜，我们都以前辈马首是瞻。”……此刻，田伯光等人都无语的很，哭泣的很伤心，他们本来是看到云峰有很多灵石，打算打劫他的，哪知道云峰是一个扮猪吃老虎的高手，起码是金丹期，一时间他们心里后悔死了。“厉道友，没想到你这么强！”“厉道友，你真了不起。”……此刻，受伤的周姓修士、李姓修士也走了过来，他们看着云峰的眼睛里都是佩服，心里也开心的很。毕竟云峰是他们的队友，云峰这么强悍，他们自然是欢喜的。“呵呵，这有什么，跟着我混，没有人能欺负你们。好了，我们走了。”云峰笑道，然后手一挥，开始赶路了，毕竟云峰的目的是去火焰山寻找神木王鼎的，这个是主要任务。秘境的时间只有24个时辰，不能耽误。“爸爸，你真的给他们吃了毒药啊？那些药丸子毒药我怎么没见过。”在路上，林不悔则看着云峰好奇的询问道。云峰的空间戒指的毒药林不悔一般都是见过的，但是从来没看到过那些泥丸之类的毒药。听到女儿的询问，云峰凑到了女儿的耳朵边小声道：“爸爸是骗他们的，那药丸都是爸爸从身体上捏下来的污垢，不骗他们，怎么会对爸爸我忠心。”“哈哈！”听到云峰的话，林不悔大笑起来，笑的合不拢嘴。林不悔本来就是美女，如此一笑之下更加美丽了，如同仙女下凡一样。这让跟在后面的田伯光忍不住吞咽了一下口水，不过田伯光也知道这个美女是云峰的女人，他自然不敢动心思的。

Be my dog (Be my dog (page 22)) Yunfeng looked at Tian Boguang and others and sneered, and said these words. "Okay, sure, we will do it. From now on, I, Tian Boguang, will be the senior's dog. Even if my senior asks me to eat shit, I will eat it." Tian Boguang knelt on the ground and kowtowed to Yunfeng, and the other monks of the Xuanyin Sect did the same. "Haha, in order to prevent you from rebelling, you must take this poison." Yunfeng smiled. He said, stretched out his palm, and saw many small black pills in his palm. The pills seemed to be poison. "What? Let's take poison." Tian Boguang's face changed when he saw the small pills in Yunfeng's hand. His expression changed, and he hesitated. Bang! The next second, Yun Feng slapped Tian Boguang on the face, knocking him to the ground. Half of Tian Boguang's face was swollen, blood was pouring from his mouth, and many of his teeth were broken. "Take medicine, or die, you have to choose. My patience is limited." Yun Feng said coldly. "Eat, it's better to take medicine." Tian Boguang cried, still choosing to take medicine. Now he didn't want to die. Tian Boguang took a pill with his hand and put it into his mouth. Yunfeng put the pill in his hand into his mouth and ate it. "Very good, this poison is Broken Chang Powder. If you don't have my unique antidote within a month, your intestines will rot and die. But as long as you obey, I will give you the antidote. I will give you the antidote when you leave the secret realm." Yunfeng looked at them and sneered, and said the name of the poison. "I know, senior!" "Ugh, we are all seniors. "...At this moment, Tian Boguang and others were speechless and crying very sadly. They originally saw Yunfeng had many spiritual stones and planned to rob him, but they didn't know that Yunfeng was a master of pretending to be a pig and eating a tiger. They regretted it for a moment. "Fellow Daoist Li, I didn't expect you to be so strong!" "Fellow Daoist Li, you are amazing."...At this moment, the injured monks surnamed Zhou and Li also came over. They looked at Yunfeng with admiration in their eyes, and they were very happy in their hearts. After all, Yunfeng is their teammate, and Yunfeng is so strong, so they are naturally happy. "Haha, what's the matter, follow me, no one can bully you. Okay, let's go." Yunfeng said with a smile, then waved his hand and started to go. After all, Yunfeng's purpose is to go to the Flame Mountain to find the divine tree king tripod. This is the main task. Time can't be delayed. "Dad, did you really give them poison? I haven't seen those pills and poisons before." On the way, Lin Buhui looked at Yunfeng and asked curiously. Lin Buhui had usually seen the poison in Yunfeng's space ring, but he had never seen poisons like those mud pills. After hearing his daughter's inquiry, Yunfeng leaned into her ear and whispered: "Dad, those pills are all from Dad. How could I be loyal to my father if I didn't lie to them about the dirt I pinched from my body?" "Haha!" Hearing Yunfeng's words, Lin Buhui laughed from ear to ear. Lin Buhui was already a beauty, and she became even more beautiful with such a smile, like a fairy descending from the earth. This made Tian Boguang who was following behind swallow his saliva, but Tian Boguang also knew that this beauty was Yunfeng's woman, so he naturally didn't dare to think about her.
